title: SS28 Women's Season Colour Analysis
summary: SS28 womenswear colour is projected to bring royal blue and greyish mauve forward, over straw and bleached linen, with darker after-dusk tones for evening.
research_period: SS28 previews published November 2025 to November 2026; SS27 runway record

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Long-range projection. SS28 fabric fairs open with Première Vision Paris on 26-28 January 2027, and the shows run from June to October 2027. This report projects from the first SS28 forecaster and fair previews, the SS27 runways and long-term market and regulatory drivers. Forecut will update it after the fairs and again after the shows.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Forecut's SS28 colour forecast: royal blue and a new turquoise beside greyish mauve and violet, over straw and bleached linen, with an after-dark edge<sup>[1]</sup>
- Future Snoops' SS28 colour shift "After Dusk": "Deep aubergines, inky blues and murky greens are bringing a darker, more atmospheric mood to warm-weather dressing"<sup>[2]</sup>
- Its named colours include Aubergine Skin, Solar Midnight, Smoky Lavender and Swamp Green, with Cloud Bloom as a luminous counterpoint and Fruit Punch for "juicy intensity"; dark shades work best with contrast, not head to toe<sup>[2]</sup>
- Copenhagen SS27 data showed colour returning and neutrals fading; Jacquemus built its SS27 show around turquoise and orange<sup>[3]</sup>

sections.heading: Colour groups
sections.body:
- **Core:** bleached linen, straw, inky blue.
- **Seasonal:** royal blue, greyish mauve.
- **Accent:** magnetic violet, peach.

sections.heading: By product
sections.body:
- Royal blue: shirts, dresses, tailoring.
- Greyish mauve: sheer layers, knits.
- Inky blue: evening, after-dusk dressing.
- Straw and linen: summer bases, raffia accessories.

design_implications: - Lab-dip key colours on each main fabric before committing.
commercial_implications: - Keep the core deep and the accents shallow until the fairs confirm them.
